title: jukecord
description: jukecord's metrics: what plays, getting tracks, the web server, the database, Discord and the process.

panels.title: Ready
panels.description: What /readyz answers: the database, the bus and the shared cache work.

panels.title: Discord
panels.description: The bot's gateway: connected, or not; browser-only when jukecord runs without a bot.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: The version and the role (all, core, edge) of each process.

panels.title: Up for
panels.description: Since the process started.

panels.title: Playing
panels.description: Servers whose player is playing now.

panels.title: Browsers playing along
panels.description: Browsers playing a server's music now ("Listen" in the panel).

panels.title: Queued
panels.description: Tracks waiting in every queue.

panels.title: Players by state
panels.description: Servers with a player, by what it is doing.

panels.title: Queues
panels.description: Tracks waiting in all queues, and in the longest one.

panels.title: People
panels.description: Open panels (live connections), the browsers among them playing along, and voice connections.

panels.title: Fetches a minute
panels.description: Tracks fetched into the media cache (downloaded and encoded), by how each ended.

panels.title: Failures a minute, by why
panels.description: Why fetches failed, in the words the panel shows (bot-check: YouTube refuses this server).

panels.title: Fetches under way
panels.description: Fetches running and waiting for their turn: now (somebody waits) or ahead (the next tracks).

panels.title: How long a fetch takes
panels.description: From its start to the track in the cache.

panels.title: yt-dlp and FFmpeg runs a minute
panels.description: Each run by program, by what it was for and how it ended.

panels.title: yt-dlp and FFmpeg runs, 90th percentile
panels.description: How long the runs take, by program and what they were for.

panels.title: Media cache
panels.description: Bytes in the media cache, and its limit (JUKECORD_CACHE_MAX).

panels.title: Found in the cache
panels.description: Of the tracks plays asked for in this time range, the share that was cached already.

panels.title: Tracks cached
panels.description: Tracks in the media cache, and their covers.

panels.title: Evicted an hour
panels.description: Files the cache removed to stay under its limit; many while the same tracks are fetched again means a cache too small.

panels.title: Free on the disk
panels.description: Free space on the disk holding the data folder (the database, the media cache, the logs).

panels.title: Answers a second
panels.description: HTTP answers, by status class.

panels.title: How long answers take
panels.description: The API's answers (the panel's files and the audio, which lasts as long as it plays, left out).

panels.title: Slowest routes (95th percentile, this time range)
panels.description: The API routes that take longest to answer.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (rate(jukecord_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route!~"static|.*/audio", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Live updates sent
panels.description: Messages a second to open panels, by frame (binary is gzip), and the bytes they took.

panels.title: Requests by route
panels.description: API requests a second, by route.

panels.title: Statements a second
panels.description: By operation; a whole transaction counts as one of its own.

panels.title: Statements, 99th percentile
panels.description: How long statements take, the wait for a connection included.

panels.title: Failed statements a minute
panels.description: Statements (and whole transactions) that failed, by operation.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Busy and idle connections, and the statements waiting for one.

panels.title: Commands to the core a second
panels.description: Commands edges sent over the bus (a split setup), by how they ended.

panels.title: Commands, 95th percentile
panels.description: How long the core took to answer, by command.

panels.title: Shared cache
panels.description: Reads that found a value, and calls to its server that failed, a second.

panels.title: Gateway
panels.description: The state the bot's gateway was in: a line for each state it held (ready, reconnecting, ...).

panels.title: Gateway latency
panels.description: The round trip of the gateway's heartbeat.

panels.title: Servers and voice
panels.description: Discord servers the bot is in, and its voice connections by state.

panels.title: Event loop delay
panels.description: Over each second; above 0.2 s at the 99th percentile jukecord turns away what can wait.

panels.title: Event loop use, and time behind
panels.description: How much of each second the loop worked, and the share of the time jukecord was behind.

panels.title: Processor
panels.description: Processor time a second (1 is one whole core).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: The process's resident memory, and the JavaScript heap.

panels.title: Open files
panels.description: Files and sockets open, and the most the process may have (Linux).
